prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Square waist-up profile illustration of ONE original adult male Hobbit of the Shire. Match precisely the approved preceding Ranger portrait's medium-density warm brown line illustration: reddish umber fine pen and pencil contours, varied fine line weight, visibly separated layered hatching and crosshatching in shadow pockets, pale ivory paper highlights and mostly blank light cream background. Style reference is the approved warm brown hatched ranger portrait. Maintain that balance of detail, neither a sparse cartoon outline nor a realistic graphite portrait.
Subject: a friendly capable adult hobbit with a round face, softly pointed ears, thick curly hair, sideburns, clean-shaven chin, bright thoughtful eyes and a small relaxed smile. Modest pastoral travelling clothes: collared shirt, buttoned waistcoat, soft short cloak over shoulders and simple leather satchel strap. His natural hand rests lightly on the satchel strap near his chest. Compact rounded shoulders and hobbit proportions, comfortable homely charm without caricature. Three-quarter view, centered readable face with margin for profile cropping, chest and waistcoat clearly visible. Subtle leaf-shaped cloak fastening.
Draw curls as locks with cream highlights between dark brown hatched pockets. Give face selective expressive lines and moderate hatching beneath brow, beside nose and under jaw. Clothing folds use directional hatching; rich small darks beneath collar and overlapping cloak, broad lit fabric remains pale unmarked paper. A few fine seams and waistcoat buttons. Tiny sparse halo of sketch hatching behind shoulders fades into blank paper. Warm brown strokes rather than gray graphite, no colored fills. No landscape, lettering, border, watermark, photographic likeness, smooth blended tonal shading, skin pores, solid brown fills or thick cartoon outlines. One character only. Square 1:1, intended 640x640 WebP profile asset.
styleReference: Approved warm brown hatched Ranger profile portrait.
